trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Earn all other 54 trophies in the list
Complete the main story through Chapter 4 and the final mission
Reach 100% completion for 'A Long Road'
Finish all grindy trophies: 250 stunts, 100 vehicles, 50 challenges, etc.
trophies.guide: The platinum requires every other trophy in the game. Focus on story trophies first through natural progression, then dedicate cleanup sessions to collectibles like meditation spots and WAiNK locations, followed by grind-heavy trophies such as 250 stunts and 100 vehicle discoveries. 100% completion is the final major hurdle. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Start a new game and play through the opening mission 'Gone Fishing'
Follow the tutorial objectives with your partner
Complete the mission to unlock the trophy automatically
trophies.guide: This is the very first mission of the game and unlocks automatically upon completion. Simply follow the on-screen prompts during the prologue — it's impossible to miss. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Progress through all main missions marked for Chapter 1
Complete the final Chapter 1 mission to trigger the chapter completion
Trophy unlocks automatically when the chapter ends
trophies.guide: Play through the Chapter 1 story missions in order. The trophy unlocks upon finishing the chapter's final mission — no side content required. Missable only if you somehow skip the entire chapter, which isn't possible in normal play. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Continue the main story into Chapter 2
Complete all mandatory Chapter 2 missions
Finish the chapter's concluding mission for the trophy
trophies.guide: Chapter 2 progresses naturally from Chapter 1. Complete all story missions in this chapter; the trophy awards automatically at the end. Cannot be missed during normal story progression. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Advance the story into Chapter 3
Finish all required Chapter 3 main missions
Complete the chapter finale to earn the trophy
trophies.guide: Continue the main narrative through Chapter 3's missions. The trophy triggers upon completing the chapter's final story mission. Unmissable in standard playthrough. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Enter Chapter 4 of the main campaign
Complete every mandatory Chapter 4 mission
The trophy unlocks when the chapter concludes
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 4's story missions sequentially. Trophy unlocks automatically upon finishing the chapter's last mission. Cannot be missed if you complete the story. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Progress through all prior chapters to reach the final mission
Complete the game's climactic final mission
Trophy unlocks upon mission completion (gold grade)
trophies.guide: This gold trophy awards for beating the final story mission. Reach it by completing Chapters 1-4, then finish the endgame mission. Unmissable — you must finish the story to reach it. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: Trust
steps: Reach the 'Breakfast Run' main mission in Chapter 1
Complete the mission objectives with your partner
Trophy unlocks automatically upon completion
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a mandatory Chapter 1 story mission. Simply play through it as part of normal progression — the trophy cannot be missed. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Progress to 'The Cartel Heist' mission in Chapter 2
Execute the heist by following mission objectives
Trophy awards upon mission completion
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is a main story mission in Chapter 2. Complete it as part of the narrative — no special requirements. Unmissable during normal play. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Reach the 'Child's Play' mission in Chapter 2
Finish all mission objectives
Trophy unlocks automatically
trophies.guide: Child's Play is a required Chapter 2 story mission. Play through it normally to earn the trophy. Cannot be missed. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Advance to the 'Headliners' mission in Chapter 3
Complete the mission's objectives
Trophy triggers on completion
trophies.guide: Headliners is a mandatory Chapter 3 story mission. Finish it during normal progression for the trophy. Unmissable. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Reach 'VCIA Takedown' in Chapter 3
Complete the infiltration and objectives
Trophy awards upon finishing the mission
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is a required Chapter 3 mission. Play through it as the story dictates — the trophy is guaranteed. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Progress to 'Operation Savage Glory' in Chapter 4
Complete the operation's objectives
Trophy unlocks when the mission ends
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a main Chapter 4 mission. Complete it during story progression for the trophy. Cannot be missed. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the main story first
Complete all stranger mission strands (8 total)
Find all collectibles: meditation spots, WAiNK locations, cards, vehicles
Finish all activities: stunts, races, shooting range, drone races, etc.
Check the pause menu completion tracker and clear remaining items
trophies.guide: 100% completion is the biggest time investment after the story. Tackle it in phases: first wrap up all stranger strands and unique missions, then hunt collectibles using maps, then grind activities like stunts and races. Use the in-game completion tracker to monitor progress. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Find stunt locations marked on the map (ramps, jumps, etc.)
Perform unique stunts — repeats don't count toward the 250
Use fast vehicles and motorcycles for easier stunt chains
Track progress in the challenges/stats menu
trophies.guide: You need 250 unique stunt jumps across Leonida. Focus on this during cleanup — use a fast bike or car and hit every marked stunt location. The game tracks unique stunts only, so avoid repeating the same jump. Check your stats menu to monitor count. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
steps: Participate in each of the 9 activity types at least once
Activities include: races, drone races, shooting range, fishing, arcade, meditation, hunting, bowling, card games
Trophy unlocks after sampling all 9
trophies.guide: Simply try each of the nine activity types once — no need to master or complete them. Most become available by Chapter 2. Knock this out early while exploring. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
steps: Visit all Shooting Range locations across Leonida
Complete all 42 challenges (pistol, rifle, shotgun, etc.)
Earn gold medal (highest score tier) on every challenge
Practice each weapon type to learn patterns
trophies.guide: Gold medals on all 42 Shooting Range challenges requires precision and practice. Tackle this in cleanup — focus on one weapon class at a time, learn the target patterns, and retry until gold. Some challenges are significantly harder than others. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
steps: Find all 14 Top Fun Drone Race locations on the map
Win a race at each location (1st place required)
Upgrade drone handling if struggling with controls
trophies.guide: Win one drone race at each of the 14 mapped locations. The races are short but require clean flying. Practice the tracks and consider drone upgrades for better handling. Can be done anytime after unlocking drone races. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Enter 20 distinct race events (street, off-road, water, etc.)
Finish 1st in each unique race
Repeats of the same race don't count — must be 20 different ones
trophies.guide: Win 20 unique races across all types. Focus on this during cleanup using a fast, well-tuned vehicle. The game tracks unique race victories, so check your stats to avoid repeating. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
steps: Find Cal's fishing challenge location (marked on map)
Accept the challenge and compete against Cal
Catch a larger/heavier fish than Cal within the time limit
trophies.guide: Cal's fishing challenge appears in Chapter 2. Use the right bait for the target fish, cast accurately, and reel efficiently. One win is all you need. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Find any arcade cabinet (bars, arcades, etc.)
Play and finish one full game (win or lose)
Trophy unlocks upon completion
trophies.guide: Walk up to any arcade machine, insert money, and play a game to completion. Available from early Chapter 1. Quick and unmissable. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
steps: Find and start Andy's stranger mission strand
Progress through all of Andy's missions in order
Complete his final mission to unlock the trophy
Do this before finishing Chapter 3 or the strand may become unavailable
trophies.guide: Andy's mission strand unlocks in Chapter 2-3. Complete all his missions sequentially; the final one awards this trophy. This strand can be missed if you advance the story too far without finishing it — prioritize stranger missions as they appear. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
steps: Trigger Kenton's stranger mission line
Complete each mission in his strand
Finish his final mission for the trophy
Complete before end of Chapter 3 to avoid missing it
trophies.guide: Kenton's strand becomes available in Chapter 2-3. Play through all his missions to the end. Like other stranger strands, it can become unavailable if you progress the main story past a certain point without finishing. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
steps: Start Billy's stranger mission strand
Work through all missions in sequence
Complete the final mission for the trophy
Must be done before Chapter 4 ends
trophies.guide: Billy's missions unlock in Chapter 3-4. Finish the full strand for the trophy. This is missable if you complete Chapter 4 without wrapping up his storyline — do stranger missions promptly. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
steps: Find all 8 stranger mission givers across Leonida
Complete every mission in each of the 8 strands
Track progress in the stranger missions menu
Finish all before the point of no return in Chapter 4
trophies.guide: There are 8 full stranger strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret, plus two others). Each has multiple missions. Complete all 8 for this silver trophy. Several strands are missable if you rush the main story — do them as they unlock. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
steps: Locate Randy and begin his mission strand
Progress through all his missions
Complete the final mission for the trophy
Finish before Chapter 3 concludes
trophies.guide: Randy's strand appears in Chapter 2-3. Complete all missions in order. Missable if you advance past Chapter 3 without finishing — handle stranger missions early. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
steps: Start Tyrone's stranger mission line
Complete each mission sequentially
Finish his final mission to earn the trophy
Complete before end of Chapter 4
trophies.guide: Tyrone's missions unlock in Chapter 3-4. Play through the full strand. Missable if Chapter 4 ends before you finish — prioritize stranger content. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
steps: Find all 18 meditation spots marked on the map
Interact with each spot to meditate
Trophy unlocks after the 18th meditation
trophies.guide: There are 18 meditation locations scattered across Leonida. Use an online map or the in-game collectibles tracker to find them all. Visit each and hold the interact button to meditate. Do this in cleanup phase. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
steps: Meet Bret and start his hunting mission
Track and kill the unique animal he requests
Return to Bret to complete the mission and earn trophy
Available in Chapter 2 — don't delay
trophies.guide: Bret's hunting mission appears in Chapter 2. Track the unique animal using your hunting skills, take it down, and return to Bret. This is part of a stranger strand and can be missed if you progress too far without doing it. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Find collectible cards throughout Leonida (loot, shops, rewards)
Complete any 3 full card sets
Check your collection menu for progress on each set
Trade or buy missing cards if needed
trophies.guide: Collect cards from various sources — looting, purchasing, mission rewards — until you complete 3 full sets. The collection menu shows which cards you're missing. Can be grindy; focus on this during cleanup. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Locate all 100 WAiNK It spots across the map
Interact with each to 'WAiNK It'
Use online maps for efficient routing
Track progress in the collectibles menu
trophies.guide: 100 WAiNK It locations are scattered throughout Leonida. This is a major collectible hunt — use a community map to plan efficient routes. Do it in cleanup; the in-game tracker shows your count. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Open the Challenges menu to see all available challenges
Complete 50 distinct challenges (combat, driving, exploration, etc.)
Focus on easy/quick challenges first
Progress carries across all categories
trophies.guide: The game has numerous challenge categories (combat, traversal, exploration, etc.). Complete any 50 total — they don't need to be from the same category. Check the Challenges menu and knock out the easiest ones first during cleanup. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
steps: Reach a 4-star wanted level while with your story partner
Evade the police together until the wanted level clears
Use alleys, tunnels, and off-road paths to break line of sight
trophies.guide: Get a 4-star wanted level during a mission or free-roam with your partner active, then escape the search radius. Easiest during certain story missions where partners are forced. Can be done in Chapter 2+. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
steps: Have your partner with you (story mission or free-roam)
Rob three different stores in quick succession
Keep wanted level low — don't let it drop to zero between robberies
Escape after the third robbery
trophies.guide: With your partner active, rob three shops consecutively while maintaining a wanted level the entire time. Best done in a dense urban area with many stores close together. Available from Chapter 2 onward. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Drive/enter 100 unique vehicle models
Check the vehicle collection tracker in the pause menu
Visit dealerships, spawn points, and steal diverse vehicles
Focus on rare/spawn-specific vehicles last
trophies.guide: Enter or drive 100 distinct vehicle models. The game tracks discovered vehicles in your collection menu. Visit vehicle spawns, dealerships, and steal everything you see. Do this in cleanup — it's a numbers game. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
steps: Build up Combat Focus meter (combat actions)
Activate Combat Focus (slow-mo ability)
Kill 5 enemies before the meter depletes
Best done in a heavy combat encounter
trophies.guide: Fill your Combat Focus meter, activate it, and quickly eliminate 5 enemies while time is slowed. Easiest during intense story missions or gang hideouts with many enemies. Available once Combat Focus unlocks in Chapter 2. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
steps: Progress to the VCIA mission in Chapter 3
During the mission, trigger the 'unscheduled departure' sequence
Trophy unlocks as part of the story beat
trophies.guide: This triggers during a specific Chapter 3 mission at the VCIA facility. The 'unscheduled departure' is a scripted story moment — just play the mission normally. Unmissable. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Encounter Rhino tanks (military vehicles) in Chapter 4
Destroy or deal with them as the mission/objective requires
Trophy unlocks upon completing the tank encounter
trophies.guide: Rhino tanks appear in a Chapter 4 mission. Complete the required objective involving them — destroy, hijack, or survive. It's a story-integrated encounter. Unmissable if you play Chapter 4. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
steps: Find a jewelry store (marked on map)
Enter stealthily — avoid cameras and guards
Grab the loot and exit without triggering an alarm
Use silenced weapons or melee if needed
trophies.guide: Rob any jewelry store completely undetected. Move slowly, stay out of camera cones, take out guards silently, and leave before the alarm triggers. Available from Chapter 2. Quick with a stealthy approach. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Locate 5 distinct bank vault robbery opportunities
Complete each heist: breach, grab, escape
Successfully escape the law after each
Can be done in free-roam or specific missions
trophies.guide: Rob 5 different bank vaults and escape alive each time. These are major heist activities — plan your approach, bring heavy firepower, and have an escape vehicle ready. Best tackled in cleanup with good gear. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
steps: Find an armored truck driving the streets
Stop it (ram, shoot tires, block path)
Breach the back doors and take the cash
Escape the responding police
trophies.guide: Ambush an armored truck in free-roam, breach it, grab the cash, and lose the cops. Trucks spawn randomly on roads — follow one until it stops or force it to stop. Available from Chapter 2. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Reveal all 52 named areas/regions on the map
Drive/fly/walk into each undiscovered zone
Watch for the area name popup on screen
Use a helicopter or fast car for efficiency
trophies.guide: Visit all 52 named regions of Leonida to reveal them on the map. The area name appears on screen when you enter a new zone. Use a helicopter or fast vehicle to cover ground quickly during cleanup. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
steps: Identify illegal operations for all 9 gangs on the map
Rob one operation per gang (9 total)
Each gang has distinct operation types (labs, farms, etc.)
Complete all 9 for the trophy
trophies.guide: There are 9 gangs in Leonida, each with illegal operations (drug labs, chop shops, etc.). Rob one operation from each gang. Map markers show gang territories. Do this in cleanup when you have good weapons and armor. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach area (Vice City)
Find a beachside bar or restaurant with a view
Order and drink a cocktail
Trophy unlocks immediately
trophies.guide: Visit a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach in Vice City, buy a cocktail, and drink it. Available from early Chapter 1. A quick, fun trophy — just enjoy the view. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
steps: Find a vehicle showroom (dealership)
Drive a vehicle through the front window/doors
Exit the building in the vehicle
Trophy triggers on the dramatic exit
trophies.guide: Locate a car dealership, get in a display vehicle, and smash through the glass front to exit. The 'classic style' refers to the dramatic showroom exit. Available from Chapter 2. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley
Play a game of bowling
Complete the game (score doesn't matter)
Trophy unlocks after finishing
trophies.guide: Visit the specific Kolt & Associates bowling alley location, play a full game of bowling, and finish it. Winning isn't required — just complete the game. Available from Chapter 2. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: Progress through the partner-related story content in Chapter 3
Complete the specific partnership moment/mission
Trophy unlocks at a key narrative beat
Cannot be replayed if missed — watch for the story cue
trophies.guide: This triggers at a specific story moment with your partner in Chapter 3. It's a narrative beat that can be missed if you make certain choices or skip dialogue. Pay attention during partner-focused missions in Chapter 3. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Make choices throughout the game (dialogue, mission approaches, etc.)
The game tracks a hidden choice counter
Reach 500 total choices made
Replay missions or grind dialogue choices if needed
trophies.guide: The game tracks every meaningful choice you make across dialogue and gameplay. You need 500 total. Natural playthrough won't reach this — grind by replaying missions with different choices or exhausting dialogue trees in cleanup. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: Fail any mission, challenge, or activity
Retry and succeed on the second attempt
Trophy unlocks on the successful retry
trophies.guide: Simply fail something (mission, race, challenge) and then succeed on your immediate retry. Will happen naturally during play. If not, intentionally fail and retry a simple activity. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: Progress to the strange encounter in Chapter 3
Witness the unusual event (story-related)
Trophy unlocks automatically upon witnessing
trophies.guide: A scripted strange encounter occurs in Chapter 3. Play the story and you'll witness it — the trophy triggers automatically. Unmissable if you complete Chapter 3. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
steps: Get on a motorcycle or passenger seat of a vehicle
Equip a melee weapon
Drive past pedestrians and hit 1 with a melee attack
Knock them down (bowling pin style)
trophies.guide: While on a motorcycle or as a passenger, swing a melee weapon at a pedestrian to knock them down. Simple — find a crowded area, drive by, and swing. Available from Chapter 2 when melee drive-bys unlock. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
steps: Acquire Marked Bills from robberies, heists, or missions
Visit your laundering contacts
Process Marked Bills into clean cash
Accumulate $250,000 total laundered
trophies.guide: Collect Marked Bills from criminal activities, then use your laundering contacts to convert them. You need $250K total cleaned. Grind robberies and heists for bills, then launder in batches during cleanup. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Accumulate $100,000+ in clean cash
Visit various shops (clothing, weapons, vehicles, properties)
Spend money across different shop types
Total spending must reach $100,000
trophies.guide: Spend $100K total across all shop categories — clothes, guns, cars, properties, etc. Easy if you've been earning through heists and missions. Just buy expensive items until the tracker hits $100K. Do in cleanup. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Find all 8 garage properties for sale on the map
Purchase each one (requires significant cash)
Total cost is high — save up from heists/businesses
Trophy unlocks after buying the 8th garage
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties across Leonida. They're expensive — you'll need millions. Focus on income-generating activities (heists, businesses) first, then purchase all garages in cleanup. Source: PowerPyx

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
steps: Unlock the Scooter Bros app (story progression)
Find and steal/buy 10 different vehicles
Register each vehicle in the Scooter Bros app
Trophy unlocks after the 10th registration
trophies.guide: Once the Scooter Bros app unlocks, register 10 unique vehicles in it. Steal or buy diverse vehicles, then use the app to register them. Simple collection task — do it in cleanup. Source: PowerPyx
